label_provenance.review_scope: whether the quoted source evidence directly supports AND/OR among the supplied same-scope candidate causes
label_provenance.rule: A list of possible causes alone does not establish OR; a list conjunction alone does not establish AND; use unknown when the source excerpt does not state the combination relation.
label_provenance.review_note: AI role review only; not human domain-expert sign-off or project Gold.

inference_input_policy: Model receives only parent event, direct child event texts, and the exact transcribed source scope evidence. Source identity, page/document metadata, expected labels, reviewer notes, and expected gate evidence are withheld.
scope_note: Small external text-evidence abstention probe. It tests whether the model distinguishes an enumerated possible-cause set from explicit logical evidence and preserves unknown; it is not an end-to-end FTA test, calibration set, or production policy test.

gate_nodes.parent_event: One of the Apollo 15 main parachutes failed and collapsed during descent.
gate_nodes.parent_evidence: the failure of one of the three main parachutes of the Apollo 15 spacecraft, which collapsed at approximately 1825 meters
gate_nodes.candidate_set_evidence: three conditions considered to be possible causes of the failure were produced. The suspect conditions were the proximity of the forward heat shield that passed the spacecraft at approximately 1825 meters, the dumping of the reaction control system hypergolic propellants at approximately 1825 meters, and the failing of a riser link found on a recovered parachute.
children: Forward heat shield passed in close proximity to the spacecraft.
A riser link found on a recovered parachute failed.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The abstract calls these suspect possible causes, but does not say whether any one alone is sufficient or whether multiple conditions must co-occur. The grammatical 'and' closing the list is not a logical-gate statement.

gate_nodes.parent_event: Engine starts but does not continue running.
gate_nodes.parent_evidence: Engine starts but does not continue running.
children: Air lock in fuel supply system.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The manual places eight entries under a Possible cause column for this symptom, but the cited scope does not state their AND/OR combination. The table/list structure alone is insufficient.

children: Fuel line air leak between tank and fuel pump.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The source lists six possible causes under one symptom, without a statement that any one is sufficient or that all/particular combinations are required.

gate_nodes.parent_event: Cabin temperature does not respond to control during auto or manual operation.
gate_nodes.parent_evidence: Trouble: Cabin temperature too high or too low (will not respond to control during auto or manual operation).
gate_nodes.candidate_set_evidence: Defective temperature control or refrigeration bypass valve inoperative.
gate_nodes.expected_gate_evidence: Defective temperature control or refrigeration bypass valve inoperative.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The word 'or' directly joins the two alternative causes in the Possible Cause cell. The separate 'or' in the parent symptom is not the gate evidence.

limitations: Only four nodes from four source-document clusters; three unknown cases and one OR positive control are a small exploratory probe, not representative validation.
